Agent Name: FileSurfer  
Step Number: 2  
Reason for Mistake: FileSurfer failed to extract the necessary ORCID publication data during its initial attempts to visit and summarize the ORCID pages. Although the ORCID profiles were repeatedly accessed, there was no concrete attempt to extract or count pre-2020 publications from the "Works" section, nor were any publication years identified or processed. This lack of data collection directly prevented further steps from calculating the average, leading to an incomplete solution.
